lines.japanese: 今日は俺が楽しみにしていた新アニメ『熊と親父と農作業』の放送日なんだ。今週は原作だと屈指の萌え回と評判の話だから、なんとかリアル視聴したい。
lines.english: Today was the day they aired the new anime I’d been looking forward to, *The Bear, the Old Man, and Farm Work*. This week’s episode covered a chapter famous as one of the most heart-melting in the source, so I desperately wanted to watch it live.

lines.japanese: 高内さんには申し訳ないが、ここはアニメの方を優先させてもらおう。
lines.english: I felt bad for Takauchi, but the anime would have to come first.

lines.japanese: 「悪い、副委員長。せっかくの誘いだが、俺は今から花水木へ急いで向かい、そのあともすぐに帰らなくちゃいけないんだ」
lines.english: “Sorry, Vice Rep. I appreciate the invitation, but I need to hurry to Flowering Dogwood Street now, then rush straight home afterward.”

lines.japanese: 「だからまた今度誘ってくれないか」
lines.english: “Could you ask me again some other time?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そー。じゃ、今日は一人で帰るわ」
lines.english: “Oh, sure. Guess I'll walk home alone today.”

lines.japanese: 高内さんはとんとんと足で地面を突いてから、フンと息を漏らした。
lines.english: Takauchi tapped the ground with one foot, then snorted.

lines.japanese: せっかく誘ってくれたのに悪いことをした。そのうち別の機会で借りは返そう。
lines.english: I felt bad turning her down after she'd gone to the trouble of inviting me. I would make it up to her another time.

lines.japanese: 「あーあ、その辺に退屈しのぎの後輩が転がってねえかなあ」
lines.english: “Man, isn't there some underclassman lying around I can use to kill time?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあね、高内さん」
lines.english: “See you, Takauchi.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃーね」
lines.english: “Later.”

lines.japanese: しばらくその場に立って高内さんを見送っていたら、昇降口の向こう側で声が聞こえた。どうやら、退屈しのぎの後輩は見つかったらしい。
lines.english: I stood there and watched Takauchi leave. Before long, I heard voices beyond the school entrance. Apparently, she had found an underclassman to kill time with.

lines.japanese: 「おっ、林田。ちょーどいいとこにいたわ、オメちょっと付きあえよ」
lines.english: “Oh, Hayashida. Perfect timing. Come hang out with me.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、なんです？　高内先輩、どこか寄るんですか？」
lines.english: “Huh? What is it, Takauchi? Are you stopping somewhere?”

lines.japanese: 「そ。茶ァするから付きあえ」
lines.english: “Yeah. I'm getting tea. Come with me.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はいっ。じゃあお荷物お持ちします」
lines.english: “Y-yes! Then please allow me to carry your bag.”

lines.japanese: 「ばっかおまえ、学校の入口とか目立つ場所でへこへこすんなッつってんだろ」
lines.english: “Idiot. I told you not to grovel in a conspicuous place like the school entrance.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい、それでは校門を出てからお持ちします」
lines.english: “Y-yes. Then I will carry it once we have left the school gate.”

lines.japanese: 「変わんねーよ、距離こっから１００メートルもねーじゃねーか」
lines.english: “That's no different! The gate's not even a hundred meters from here!”

lines.japanese: どうやら高内さんは高内さんで楽しく帰れそうだな。
lines.english: It seemed Takauchi would have a pleasant walk home too.

lines.japanese: 気に病むものがなくなった俺は、追いつかないよう、ブルガリ一本分飲みほしてから校門をくぐった。
lines.english: With nothing left to worry about, I finished a carton of Bulgari before heading through the gate, giving them time to get ahead.

lines.japanese: おっ？　あれは……。
lines.english: Hm? Was that...?

lines.japanese: 小鳩とアリスじゃないか。
lines.english: Kobato and Alice.

lines.japanese: ふむ、良い子の我が妹が何故こんなところに……はっ！　まさか小鳩のやつ、放課後は柳木原でやんちゃタイムを！？
lines.english: Hmm. What was my good little sister doing here...? Wait! Don't tell me Kobato spent her afternoons cutting loose in Yanagihara!

lines.japanese: これはいけない、お兄ちゃんとして良い子の二人に注意してやらねば！　こら小鳩！　寄り道なんていけません！
lines.english: This would not stand. As her big brother, I had to reprimand both good girls! Now, Kobato! You mustn't make stops on your way home!

lines.japanese: 「ここのパン屋さんね、お兄ちゃんがすごく気に入ってるから、明日の朝ごはんに用意してあげたかったんだ」
lines.english: “My brother really likes this bakery, so I wanted to get something for his breakfast tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: うわあん、小鳩おおおおお！　ああもうなんて優しいんだ。もはや俺一人の妹にしておくにはもったいない。世界の妹と呼んで差支えない。
lines.english: Waaaaah, Kobatooooo! How could she be so sweet? Keeping her all to myself would be a crime. The world would be justified in calling her its little sister.

lines.japanese: なにっ、俺の小鳩を俺以外のやつが妹にするだと！　ふざけるな、小鳩のお兄ちゃんは俺だけだ！　つまり小鳩と結婚していいのも俺しかいないってことだよね。
lines.english: What?! Someone besides me wants to make Kobato his little sister? Fuck that! I'm Kobato's only big brother! Which means I'm the only one allowed to marry her too, right?

lines.japanese: 「おーい」
lines.english: “Heeey!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、お兄ちゃん？」
lines.english: “Huh? Big Brother?”

lines.japanese: 「ドラ？　もしかして私たちを付けていたのですか」
lines.english: “Dora? Were you perhaps following us?”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、俺、ストーカーとか立ち聞きとかまるでないからね。ちょっとそこのレストランに用事が……」
lines.english: “No, no. I have never stalked or eavesdropped in my life. I only had some business at that restaurant...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだ。二人ともなにか飲み物でもどうだい？　良い子の二人に、お兄ちゃんがおごってあげるよ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Would you two like something to drink? Big Brother will treat his two good girls.”

lines.japanese: 「ほんと？　うん、お兄ちゃんと一緒なら。アリスちゃんもいい？」
lines.english: “Really? Okay, if it's with you. Is that all right with you, Alice?”

lines.japanese: 「まったく彼ったらがっついてばかりね。仕方ないから付きあってあげるわ」
lines.english: “My, he is always so pushy. I suppose I will humor him.”

lines.japanese: ああもう、ほんとにかわいいなあこの子たち。もうお腹がいっぱいになるまで好きなものを食べさせてあげたい。
lines.english: Oh, they were so adorable. I wanted to let them eat whatever they pleased until they were stuffed.

lines.japanese: さあアレキサンダーでティータイムだぞーぅ。
lines.english: Come, girls! It was tea time at Alexander!

lines.japanese: ちなみにアニメに関しては、二人の天使に出会ってしまったせいで、どうでもよくなってしまったのが本音だ。
lines.english: Truthfully, meeting these two angels had made me stop caring about the anime altogether.

lines.japanese: 「いらっしゃいませ、ロリコン様――」
lines.english: “Welcome, Mr. Likes ’Em Young—”

lines.japanese: 「――って、うわっ！　鷲介じゃないか。なんだ、年齢差のある少女を二人も連れてるから、てっきりどこかの性犯罪者が紛れこんできたのかと思ったぞ」
lines.english: “—wait, Shuusuke! It's you. You came in with two much younger girls, so I mistook you for some sex offender who'd wandered in.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、こんな純粋そうな天使たちの前でなにを言うんですか。ちなみに俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないし、言われたこともないですけどね」
lines.english: “Hahaha. What are you saying in front of these innocent angels? For the record, I have no sister complex or Lolita complex whatsoever, and no one has ever accused me of either.”

lines.japanese: 「シュー……スケ？」
lines.english: “Shuu... suke?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あだ名。私もときどきそう呼ぶんだ」
lines.english: “I-it's a nickname. I call him that sometimes too.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか非番とはいえ、従業員がお邪魔しちゃっていいですか？」
lines.english: “Anyway, I know it's my day off, but is it all right for an employee to take up a table?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、もちろんだ。その代わり二人も連れがいるんだ、顧客単価をあげるためにたくさん注文してくれよ」
lines.english: “Of course. But since you've brought two companions, order plenty and raise the average spend per customer.”

lines.japanese: 「うへえ」
lines.english: “Ugh.”

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに当店は、パフェやケーキなどデザート類のメニューも充実しているのである」
lines.english: “For the record, our menu boasts an abundant selection of desserts, including parfaits and cakes.”

lines.japanese: 「パフェ？」
lines.english: “Parfaits?”

lines.japanese: 「オゥ、ケーキ。私はそれを大変好みます」
lines.english: “Oh, cake. I am extremely fond of that.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いいから早く席へ案内しなさい、この不良店長っ」
lines.english: “J-just show us to a table, you delinquent manager!”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、禁煙席でいいよな？　まあ、ゆっくりしていけ」
lines.english: “Hahaha. Nonsmoking, I assume? Take your time.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、待って一つだけ。玉泉教官は？」
lines.english: “Oh, one thing. Where's Instructor Tamaizumi?”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　玉泉君なら今日は休みとってるぞ」
lines.english: “Hm? Tamaizumi took today off.”

lines.japanese: 「げっ！」
lines.english: “Gah!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ注文が決まったら呼べよ」
lines.english: “Call when you're ready to order.”

lines.japanese: な、なんだ、玉泉のひと休みだったのか……そんな、他人のシフトなんか知らないっつの。
lines.english: S-so Tamaizumi had the day off... How was I supposed to know somebody else’s schedule?

lines.japanese: 仕方ない、確率は低いけど、明日の当日券に期待するしかなくなってきた……。
lines.english: No helping it. The odds were low, but tickets at the door tomorrow had become my only hope...

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん？　どうしたの」
lines.english: “Big Brother? What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああいや、なんでもないんだ」
lines.english: “O-oh, nothing.”

lines.japanese: はあ。小鳩はフリファ嫌いみたいだし、相談しても乗ってくれないだろうなあ。
lines.english: Sigh. Kobato seemed to dislike the Frickies, so she probably wouldn’t be much help if I asked.

lines.japanese: うん、それよりせっかく小鳩とアリスと一緒にお店へ来てるんだ。とりあえずがっかり感を減らすために、今はお茶を楽しむことにしよう。
lines.english: Besides, I was here at the restaurant with Kobato and Alice. For now, I’d enjoy my tea and try to shake off the disappointment.

lines.japanese: 「よしよし、それじゃ好きなものを頼んでいいぞ」
lines.english: “All right, then. Order anything you like.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それじゃ私アイスティー」
lines.english: “Oh. Then I'll have iced tea.”

lines.japanese: 「ケーキセット。ドリンクはコーヒーでいいわ。ブラックでね」
lines.english: “The cake set. Coffee for the drink, please. Black.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　おいおいなんだ、アリスに比べて、小鳩の注文はずいぶん素っ気ないな。お兄ちゃんがごちそうするって言ってるんだから、もっと甘えていいんだぞ」
lines.english: “What? Come on, Kobato, that's a very plain order next to Alice's. Big Brother is treating you, so you can indulge yourself more.”

lines.japanese: 「遠慮しないで、スイーツだろうがカレーライスだろうが好きに頼みなさい。オムドリアフェアもやってるよ！」
lines.english: “Don't hold back. Order sweets, curry rice, anything you like. They've got omelet-doria specials too!”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そじゃなくて。あ、それもあるけど、えと」
lines.english: “Th-that's not it. Well, partly, but, um...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 慎みぶかい小鳩のことだから遠慮してるのかと思ったけど、そうじゃない？
lines.english: Kobato was so modest that I'd assumed she was holding back, but apparently not.

lines.japanese: 「私、こういうところでなにを頼めばいいのやら」
lines.english: “I don't know what you're supposed to order at a place like this.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、なあんだ」
lines.english: “Oh, is that all?”

lines.japanese: そうか、小鳩の経済力じゃ、帰りに友達とレストランなんて寄ったことないのか。いいとこ、モンキの地下のイートインコーナーなんだろう。
lines.english: Of course. With the money Kobato had, she’d never stopped at a restaurant with friends after school. The basement eat-in area at Monki was probably the most she could afford.

lines.japanese: 「はは小鳩、買い物はできるのに、こういう場所だと尻ごみしちゃうんだなあ」
lines.english: “Haha. You can shop by yourself, but a place like this makes you timid, Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなことないよ。一人で買い物に来たこともあるし」
lines.english: “Th-that's not true. I've come shopping by myself before.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、俺が連れてくる前に、アレキサンダー来たことあったのか」
lines.english: “What? You came to Alexander before I ever brought you here?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、プレゼント用に。ちょっと嫌な目にあったけど……あっ」
lines.english: “Yes, to buy a present. Something a little unpleasant happened, though... Oh.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩はそのとき、慌てて口を押さえた。だが時すでに遅し。俺に自覚はないが、アリスが脅えた表情をしているところから察するに、恐らく般若の相を浮かべているに違いない。
lines.english: Kobato hurriedly covered her mouth, but it was too late. I had no awareness of my own expression, but Alice looked frightened, so I was probably wearing the face of a demon.

lines.japanese: 「小鳩がアレキサンダーで嫌な目にあったとな？」
lines.english: “Something unpleasant happened to Kobato at Alexander?”

lines.japanese: 「ち、ちがうよ、ちょっと困っただけ」
lines.english: “Th-that's not it. I only had a little trouble.”

lines.japanese: 「嘘おっしゃい。なんだ、なにをされた。まさかさっきの髭になにかされたんじゃないだろうな」
lines.english: “Don't lie. What happened? What did they do to you? Don't tell me that bearded man from before did something.”

lines.japanese: 「あれか。まさか卑猥な言葉をかけられて筆舌に尽くしがたい辱めを受けたのか。それとも舐めるような視線で目も当てられないセクシャルハラスメントを受けたのか」
lines.english: “Was it him? Did he subject you to indescribable humiliation with obscene remarks? Or leer at you so disgustingly that the sexual harassment defied description?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、見られてはいなっ……じゃ、じゃなくて」
lines.english: “No, nobody look—th-that's not what I meant.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ！　なにをされた！」
lines.english: “What happened?! What did they do?!”

lines.japanese: 「しましま～、今日はしましま居ないかな～」
lines.english: “Stripes, stripes... Any stripes here today?”

lines.japanese: 「ひうっ」
lines.english: “Eep!”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩の表情が気になって振りかえってみれば、いつか見た子供が店内をうろついている。あの子供は、確か紀奈子さんのひとにイチゴ的な辱めを与えた……はっ！
lines.english: I turned at Kobato's expression and saw a child I'd met before wandering around the restaurant. That boy had subjected Kinako to some strawberry-themed humiliation... Wait!

lines.japanese: 「小鳩！　まさかスカートをめくられたのか！」
lines.english: “Kobato! Did he flip up your skirt?!”

lines.japanese: 「ち、ちがっ」
lines.english: “Th-that's not—”

lines.japanese: 「そうだな？　めくられたんだな？　やつに辱めを受けたんだなっ！？」
lines.english: “He did, didn't he? He flipped it up! That wretch humiliated you!”

lines.japanese: 「お客様ご注文は。それと店内ではお静かに」
lines.english: “May I take your order? Also, please keep your voice down inside the restaurant.”

lines.japanese: 「フルーツのパフェセットとチーズケーキセット、飲み物はアイスティーとコーヒー牛乳！　俺はブルマン！」
lines.english: “Fruit-parfait set and cheesecake set! Iced tea and coffee milk! Blue Mountain for me!”

lines.japanese: 「かしこまりました」
lines.english: “Certainly.”

lines.japanese: 「ア、アリスちゃん、ケーキ楽しみだねー」
lines.english: “A-Alice, the cake will be nice, won't it?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。とても楽しみだ。小鳩にも一口わけて差しあげます」
lines.english: “Yes. I look forward to it very much. I will share a bite with you, Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「わー、うれしいなー」
lines.english: “Wow, I'm so happy.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな幸せそうな笑顔ではごまかされないぞ。俺は今から小鳩の仇を討ちにいってくる」
lines.english: “That blissful smile won't fool me. I'm going to avenge you right now.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、だからそんな大きな声で恥ずかしいことゆわないで」
lines.english: “Um, I told you, stop saying embarrassing things so loudly.”

lines.japanese: 「そこの子供！　よくもうちの大切な妹に辱めをっ！」
lines.english: “You there, child! How dare you humiliate my precious little sister!”

lines.japanese: 「や、やめて」
lines.english: “P-please stop.”

lines.japanese: 憤りを覚えてがたりと席を立ちあがると、小鳩は俺の肩をぐっと押さえた。店内の視線が俺に集まる。アリスは水をくぴくぴ飲んでいた。
lines.english: I rose from my seat in outrage, but Kobato planted a hand on my shoulder and held me down. Every eye in the restaurant turned toward me. Alice quietly sipped her water.

lines.japanese: 「小鳩、お兄ちゃんはおまえを守るのが生きがいなんだ」
lines.english: “Kobato, protecting you is Big Brother's purpose in life.”

lines.japanese: 「生きがい。それはとても大切なものです」
lines.english: “A purpose in life. That is extremely important.”

lines.japanese: 「そこの子供！　よくも小鳩のしましまパンツを見やがったな！」
lines.english: “You there, child! How dare you look at Kobato's striped panties?!”

lines.japanese: 「うっ」
lines.english: “Ugh.”

lines.japanese: 視線が俺から小鳩へ移動した。それと同時に小鳩が立った。その顔みるみる真っ赤に染まる。
lines.english: Every eye moved from me to Kobato. At the same moment, Kobato stood, her face rapidly turning scarlet.

lines.japanese: 「うわああああん、お兄ちゃんのばかあああああ！」
lines.english: “WAAAAH! BIG BROTHER, YOU IDIOT!”

lines.japanese: 「ああっ、小鳩！？」
lines.english: “Wait, Kobato?!”

lines.japanese: 俺は逃げだした小鳩の背中を見て、ようやく自分が妹を羞恥のど真ん中へ落としこんだことに気がついた。
lines.english: Only as I watched Kobato flee did I realize I had dropped my sister into the very heart of humiliation.

lines.japanese: あああ、とんでもないことをしてもうた。ごめんよ、ごめんなさい小鳩。許してくれえ。
lines.english: Oh God. I'd done something terrible. I'm sorry, Kobato. I'm so sorry. Please forgive meee.

lines.japanese: 「お客様、ご注文のフルーツパフェセットとチーズケーキセットをお持ちしました。それとブルマン」
lines.english: “Your fruit-parfait set and cheesecake set. And the Blue Mountain.”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ、ブルマンだと！」
lines.english: “What?! Blue Mountain?!”

lines.japanese: 「以上で注文はお揃いでしょうか」
lines.english: “Does that complete your order?”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ、注文がお揃いだと！」
lines.english: “What?! Everything is here?!”

lines.japanese: もう、マスターへツッコミを入れる気力も残ってない……。
lines.english: I no longer had even enough energy to retort at the boss...

lines.japanese: アリスと二人でとり残された俺は、テーブル上の注文を片付けることに勤しんだ。
lines.english: Left alone with Alice, I devoted myself to clearing everything on the table.
